Detailed Description

Represents a connection to WIC camera/module.

None of the setters in this class are reentrant. It is recommended to use it from a single thread of execution (or guard it with mutual exclusion), or via an event loop.

◆ setRangeAndLens()

Response<uint16_t> wic::WIC::setRangeAndLens ( Range  range,
const char *  lens = "",
bool  force = false,
bool  validateMemory = false 
)

Sets measurement range and lens, this settings affects applied corrections and calibrations applied to frame buffer power should not be cut before this function returns.

Available settings are supplied with wic license (.wlic file).

See also
doDefaultWICSettings attempts to autodetect internal correction data and chooses lens automatically If no license is used with the camera, internal image correction data is cleared and no external calibration can be used
calibrateRaw . If changing range without changing current lens, the command returns rather fast, uploading new lens settings can take a few minutes. Available lens/range combinations can be read from
CalibrationData::calibratedLenses or checked by calling
rangeAvailable .
Parameters
rangerange to be set
lenslens to be set
forceforces reupload of image correction data, this is equivalent to calling this command when getRangeAndLens return lens == "" should be used if image artifacts are detected
validateMemoryvalidates internal camera correction data (checking them against uploaded data), setting this parameter to true can be used as a sanity check, however it takes very long, especially on a busy network (GigE version) and in majority of uses (if not always) should be set to false
Returns
count of errors in internal correction data, function should be rerun (sometimes with force == true) if image artifacts are present max value = resolution / 128
